snippet.title: Twisted Tower - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Twisted Tower launches August 18, 2026!

From acclaimed developer Thomas Brush, the creator of Pinstripe and Neversong, comes a haunting action adventure set inside a forgotten 1950s amusement resort where childhood memories have curdled into nightmares. 

Fight your way through a tower teeming with corrupted mascots, deadly attractions, twisted puzzles, and horrifying secrets as you race to the summit in a desperate effort to save the love of your life.

The climb gets deadlier with every floor. Wield an arsenal of bizarre toy-inspired weapons and upgrade them to overcome the challenges ahead. As you ascend, be sure to explore the resort and discover its strange attractions. Go for a questionable swim in the water park, twirl on a merry-go-round, grab a hot dog of indeterminate origin, or just bonk a pesky mascot in the face with a mallet. 

The tower opens soon. Will you survive long enough to reach the top?
